![ariadne logo](man/figures/ariadne_logo.png)

> If you're going to decipher a hidden code from a complex set of different
> mazes, I'm pretty sure you need a girl's brain running the show.
> ― James Dashner, The Maze Runner

Inspired by the legend of Theseus and the Minotaur, the ever-changing (yet
reproducible) ariadne logo reflects the variable nature of the Labyrinth of
Biology. The emojis found in the labyrinth rooms represent isolated biological
entities, which ariadne attempts to connect by weaving a pathway between them.

Everything about the ariadne logo is reproducible and open source! A new
labyrinth configuration is generated every Wednesday by the
[hexSticker script](inst/scripts/make-hexSticker.R). At the same time, new
resource versions are automatically added to the package metadata. Emojis are
drawn from a selected subset of the [OpenMoji Library](https://openmoji.org/)
based on the calendar date [@gross2018openmoji]. The text is styled with the
Dancing Font as provided by the
[Font Library](https://fontlibrary.org/font/dancing-font).

There is no single solution to the ariadne logo, but you have until next
Wednesday to find all connections between the feature emojis.
